top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: China Plans to Let $568 Billion Fund Tap Southbound Bond Connect
top_signals.summary: China plans to allow its $568 billion social security fund to buy offshore bonds through an investment channel with Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, in its latest effort to boost demand for yuan assets in the Asian financial hub.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ringgit Falls to Lowest Versus Singapore Dollar Since November
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s ringgit fell to a 10-month low versus the Singapore dollar, weighed by foreign stock outflows while the island state’s currency is supported by a hawkish monetary policy stance.
